prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop website comp for PawFriend pet shelter landing page, 1536x1024 first viewport plus a visible slice of the next section
Input image: the attached Good Paws landing page is a visual reference for editorial energy, oversized pet photography, condensed typography, warm paper, and playful ink annotations. Do not copy its logo, exact layout, or text.
Primary request: Design PawFriend as a tactile adoption zine crossed with a portrait studio contact sheet. Create a complete real website hero with navigation and the beginning of a resident-gallery section.
Structure: slim navigation across the top; left third holds a two-line maximum headline 'FIND YOUR PERSON.' in enormous condensed black type; supporting copy 'Big personalities. Small bios. One very good reason to meet.'; primary CTA 'MEET THE PETS'; right two-thirds dominated by one joyful rescue dog photographed close-up, cropped beyond the frame edge; a fluorescent lime hand-painted arc behind the dog; one handwritten annotation naming the dog 'Milo' and 'Certified sock thief'; a compact proof cluster reading '312 personalities are waiting'; below the fold, begin a horizontal printed-photo resident strip with five clearly framed portrait cards and names.
Visual world: warm off-white recycled paper ground, ink-black, fluorescent lime, rescue orange, dusty pink, pale sky blue. Sharp editorial seams, nearly square photo cards that resemble taped contact prints, minimal rounded corners, no glass, no gradients, no shadows except paper lift. Use expressive compressed display type plus clean grotesk body copy.
Composition: asymmetric but readable, generous 64px gutters, one dominant focal image, CTA clearly visible on a small laptop. Headline no more than two lines.
Motion cues implied by still image: masked headline reveal and horizontal contact-sheet scrub.
Constraints: frontend comp, readable text, realistic shelter pet photography, accessible contrast, no fake awards, no invented testimonials, no SaaS cards, no excessive pills, no blue-purple gradients, no random blobs, no watermark.
